selected_records.title: Corporate report: Service Inquiry into the death of a service person in an air accident near RAF Coningsby on 25 May 2024

article.body:
# UK Ministry of Defence publishes inquiry report into fatal air accident near RAF Coningsby

The UK Ministry of Defence published a Service Inquiry report on 1 October 2026 into the death of a service person in an air accident near RAF Coningsby on 25 May 2024.

The report is listed by the ministry as a corporate report. The available information does not specify the service person’s identity, the circumstances of the accident or the inquiry’s findings.
